summary.text: Jason Gibbs is the Republican nominee for California's 27th Congressional District. He is a mechanical engineer who worked on rocket launch systems in the aerospace industry and has served on the Santa Clarita City Council since 2020, including as mayor. His campaign website says he is running on lowering the cost of living, public safety, and local control.

paragraphs.text: Describes himself on his campaign website as a lifelong Californian who lives in Santa Clarita with his wife, Chandra, and their two young children.
Earned bachelor's and master's degrees in mechanical engineering from Cal Poly San Luis Obispo.

Worked in the aerospace industry, including designing and building fueling system infrastructure for rocket programs and supporting the Delta II, Delta IV, and Atlas V launch systems, according to his campaign website.

Ran for Santa Clarita City Council in 2018 and was elected in 2020; chosen by fellow council members to serve as mayor (2022-2023 per Ballotpedia); re-elected in 2024 and took office representing District 3 on December 10, 2024, for a term ending in December 2028.
According to his campaign website, has served on the boards of the Boys and Girls Club, the Valley Industry Association, and the Salvation Army.
